messages:
incident-bot: PD - page fired for service: autoscale-dispatcher
incident-bot: Summary: queue_depth spike > 1000 for 5m, autoscaler erroring, potential capacity exhaustion
incident-bot: Link: https://pagerduty.local/incidents/PD12345 · Priority: P0

alice: ack'd, I'm on it :white_check_mark:

alice: grabbing runbook -> https://wiki.redwood/ops/autoscale-dispatcher

derek: seeing large steady inflow; queue_depth =~ 1.4k, p95 token latency ~420ms, autoscaler controller logs show `scale_loop_error` repeatedly

pagerduty: Ack recorded by alice (alice@redwood)

alice: metrics snapshot:
```
queue_depth: 1420
p95_latency_ms: 420
autoscaler_pending_ops: 0
node_provisioning: 12 pending
available_nodes: 3
```

sre-jamal: can we manual-scale to relieve backlog? kubectl scale --replicas=12 deploy/dispatcher -n infra-prod

alice: running manual scale now:
```
$ kubectl scale deploy/dispatcher --replicas=12 -n infra-prod
deployment.apps/dispatcher scaled
```

infra-runner-bot: scaling job started (job-id: scale-1736543210-1)

pm-ryan: FYI, observability shows increased 5xx on client-facing endpoint /v1/generate for a subset of customers, ~2% request failures, some chat apps timing out

derek: autoscaler controller logs:
```
E0301 12:34:01 controller.go:215] scale_loop_error: quotaExceeded: cannot create nodes: "quota maxInstances exceeded"
```

sre-jamal: looks like cloud quota blocking node provisioning. tagging @cloud-ops

alice: paging cloud-ops: @cloud-ops we need emergency quota bump for us-west-2: +8 instances, hitting customer-impacting latency

cloud-ops: acknowledged, filing support ticket with provider. ETA 22m for quota increase. Also checking preemptible pool.

alice: enabling temporary fallback routing to smaller models to reduce token cost and lower latency. Pushing route switch now.

ops-bot: route update applied: dispatch->model-variant:fast-cost-2x (traffic=20%)

pagerduty: Incident escalated to infra@redwood (escalation rule 2) — notify: derek, jamal

derek: seeing queue dropping slowly, p95 down to 320ms after scale/route updates

alice: customer impact: initial estimates ~20% of requests delayed >5s over 15m window; affected customers: finance-ingest, chat-proxy-qa, 3 enterprise tenants (IDs masked)

alice: mitigation summary: manual scale + fallback routing applied, cloud quota request in progress, monitoring for recovery. Keeping PD active until stable.

pm-ryan: thanks — I'll update stakeholders and CS with preliminary impact and mitigation notes

alice: will follow up with playbook + RCA ownership. tagging @sre-leads for postmortem

alice: closing loop here once queue < 200 and p95 < 200ms for 15m

oncall-bot: note created: incident/1736543210 - dispatcher queue saturation; owner: alice; severity: P0

alice: thanks everyone, staying on for post-incident actions :coffee:
